text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I said I'd win it this time—that today would be the day. I made sure to prepare myself, and even my predictions were in my favor…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Urghhh! What am I supposed to do now?!
choice_data_list: Don't get flustered. Just keep on keeping on.
When times get tough, turn to divination!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Whoa! That sounded just like one of the revelations from my fortune slips!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Thinking about it that way, perhaps you're my fortune slip!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Thank you, oh thank you! Please continue to guide me with your precious teachings!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: And please accept this as a token of my appreciation! It's a charm that prevents you from stubbing your pinkie toe!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: If nothing else, it looks like she's back to her cheery self.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Gasp! I can't believe I lost sight of not only myself, but the very essence of divination!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: The eye to my soul has awoken! Beep, beep! Let's get to predicting right away!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: The angle of my ears alludes to the phrase, "Where there's a will, there's a way"! Then I will do… some training!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Out of respect for Matikanefukukitaru's determination, I add some extra laps to her current training regimen.
